articles.title: Chubb’s (NYSE:CB) Q3 CY2025: Beats On Revenue
articles.mainIdea: Chubb’s (NYSE:CB) Q3 CY2025: Beats On Revenue
articles.summary: StockStory: Chubb’s (NYSE:CB) Q3 CY2025: Beats On Revenue. Global insurance provider Chubb Limited (NYSE:CB) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 7.5% year on year to $16.14 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $7.49 per share was 21.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
